verdict.rationale: Customer.io's own docs say to 'use an SDK or the Pipelines API' to get data in. They reference a mobile SDK for identifying people and sending push and in-app messages, a JavaScript client snippet, and a published OpenAPI spec. That confirms first-party SDKs exist, but their breadth and depth are barely documented in the evidence. Missing for 10: a list of supported languages and platforms, SDK install and usage docs, server-side SDK coverage for the App API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: To get data into Customer.io, use an SDK or the Pipelines API.
Identify people and send push, rich push, and in-app messages to your mobile app users.
Our JavaScript client snippet is the easiest to get started with and is universally supported as a source of data for our data-out integrations.
